arguments.body: Hi Luca, your annual gas safety check is legally due before 16 October. We have booked HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) to visit on Tuesday 13 October between 9am and 12pm; please treat this as written notice. We won't enter without your agreement. Thank you.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked the on-file gas contractor HeatRight for 13 Oct, more than 24h away and before expiry. Gave written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange. No entry without the tenant's agreement. Follow-up on 12 Oct; escalate if there is still no access by 15 Oct.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
